LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RevealingNunHabit.label: (Raven) Casual Nun Habit
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RevealingNunHabit.descript: A casual nun habit that looks ordinary but features an ingenious structure, specifically designed for Ravens who need to perform complex maneuvers. It is composed of multiple independent layers of fabric, ensuring maximum freedom of movement in any posture.
